name: Trap Life 2: RICO
summary:
Your city. Your choices. Your story.

Trap Life 2: RICO is a multiplayer VR open-world roleplaying experience where you decide how to build your reputation.

Explore Ocean City, drive through the streets, buy and customize cars, earn cash, complete missions, purchase weapons, build your character, hang out with other players, and create your own story.
